text:
[LCCO.5.0] Capture facts are an engine-internal use of the
activation-scoped fact lifecycle defined at [LSCP.2.4]. The
runtime bookkeeping below is the same machinery `scope
activation` uses for author-declared schemas; the difference is
that capture facts are engine-named (`$CaptureBindings_…`, a
synthetic name per [LLEX.10.6.1]) while the facts an author's
`emit` asserts are author-named.
